Lathe trilobe / eccentric turning + macro G-code
units.detail: Wire the 4 trilobe/eccentric engines into prism_turning AND generate macro-based G-code: X-axis modulation X(C) as a parametric profile for trilobe, eccentric-offset transform, polygon-turning G51.2 synchronization. Math: trochoidal/parametric profile + offset kinematics.

units.title: Activate acc_thermal_error -> post_inject_motion
units.detail: Wire machine-error thermal compensation into the post-processor motion injection so emitted G-code carries thermal-growth offsets.

units.title: Activate acc_volumetric / acc_abbe / acc_ball_bar -> cad_machine_capability_get
units.detail: Feed volumetric/Abbe/ball-bar error envelope into machine-capability lookup so strategy selection sees the real accuracy envelope.

units.title: Activate diamond_turning_* -> cam_strategy_recommend
units.detail: Wire diamond-turning surface/forces/wear models into CAM strategy recommendation for sub-micron finish operations.

units.title: Activate laser_interferometer_* -> machine_warmup_calculate
units.detail: Wire laser-interferometer wavelength/deadpath/comp-table into machine warmup + leveling setup.

units.title: Activate spm_* -> quality_kpis / spc_calculate
units.detail: Wire statistical-process-monitoring (Hotelling T2, PCA, HMM, SPRT) into the quality KPI + SPC surfaces.

units.title: Activate cad_probe_drift_* -> probe_routine_generate + wire PrintAccuracyProofEngine
units.detail: Wire probe-drift record/analyze/alerts into probe routine generation; wire the unwired PrintAccuracyProofEngine.
